Yeah, completely. I haven't even touched my camera in months. And I haven't checked the bird feeders with any real interest, or even cared what's coming up in the garden. It's actually really frightening because those things used to be how I felt like myself, you know? 

Like, I used to spend hours just sitting on the patio waiting for the goldfinches. We get these beautiful American Goldfinches in the spring, and they absolutely love thistle seed. I have three rescues, and the oldest one is on a special renal diet, so she needs her wet food mixed with warm water every morning, otherwise she won't touch it... but yeah, those thoughts are why I'm here.\n\nDoctor: How often have you been having these thoughts about not waking up or not turning the wheel, and have they been happening every day or just off and on?\n\nPatient: Well, it's... I feel like we just talked about this, didn't we? Are you asking the same thing again? I mean, like I said, it hasn't been two years. The depression has been hanging over me for about 11 months, even before this past month made everything feel just completely unbearable.

We rented this little cabin right on the coast, near Acadia National Park. It was so gorgeous. We went hiking almost every day, and we ate so much lobster I thought I was going to turn into one.
